resources.string: Share files and plugins over NFC
Pick a file or a plugin on one phone. The other phone receives the offer over NFC and pulls the bytes over a temporary Wi-Fi hotspot or Bluetooth. One file per touch.
The phone makes a temporary network and the other one joins it: fastest for big files
Needs no Wi-Fi: the phone becomes discoverable while it waits
NFC only carries the offer. The file itself goes over the selected link, and the link is closed right after the transfer.
%1$s is ready to be sent. Touch the other phone to the NFC spot.
Permission is required to create the link
This device cannot create a hotspot, use Bluetooth
The other phone was not found. Pair the phones once, or send over Wi-Fi.
